check_conformance_token_replay.description: Token multiset simulation on DFG model. Each DF edge (a,b) is a place p_{a,b}. Firing activity a produces tokens on all outgoing DF edges; next activity consumes from the corresponding place. Missing tokens counted when no token available. Fitness = calculate_fitness(produced, consumed, missing, remaining) via TokenReplayResult::calculate_fitness.
check_conformance_token_replay.algorithm: Rozinat & van der Aalst token replay on DFG

check_conformance_alignment.description: Synchronous product / Dijkstra alignment. State space = (trace_idx, model_idx). Sync moves cost 0, log/model moves cost 1. Optimal alignment found via priority queue. Model sequence extracted via BFS over Petri net topology.

tests.name: test_token_replay_conforming_trace_fitness_1
tests.description: Trace A->B->C conforming to model A->B->C yields fitness >= 0.99

tests.name: test_token_replay_nonconforming_trace_fitness_less_than_1
tests.description: Trace A->B->D->C against model A->B->C yields fitness < 1.0

tests.name: test_alignment_conforming_trace_zero_cost
tests.description: Trace A->B aligning to linear net A->B gives 0 alignment cost (fitting_traces=1)

tests.name: test_alignment_nonconforming_trace_has_cost
tests.description: Trace A->B->C against linear net A->B gives fitness < 1.0 and deviating_traces=1
